corrections.old_text: ህ ቀን ግን ዐሥራ አንዱ እን
corrections.corrected_text: ህ ቀን ግን አሥራ አንዱ እን
corrections.reason: The printed glyph in Column 1, Line 9 clearly has the two vertical legs of 'አ' (አሥራ አንዱ), not the rounded loop of 'ዐ'.
In the patristic Ge'ez citation 'ወለበዉ ወኮኑ ከመ ሰብእ እንዲል' ('and they understood and became like men'), the final character of 'ሰብእ' is 'እ', which was misread as 'ል'.
Both visually on the page (showing the top hook of 6th-order 'ል') and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez ('ተፈልጦሙ', 'having parted from them'), the third character is 'ል' rather than 1st-order 'ለ'.
